title: The plan: order, simulation, approval
summary: MachineArbitrator~plan(demands, now) places running tasks first, then new demands by priority; works out swap (pageable RAM beyond free RAM, plus a 10% margin); then caches (a new cache needs 15% headroom, an existing one only has to fit: hysteresis). Steps free before they take: STOP_TASK, FLUSH_CACHE, DROP_CACHE, ADD_SWAP, START_TASK, REMOVE_SWAP, ADD_CACHE. Swap removal inside its 600 s minimum lifetime is DEFERRED. Every step has a cause, actions and an inverse; every step but ASK_CLUSTER is marked NEEDS TOM'S DIRECT APPROVAL. The plan is simulated on a copy of the state; a step that breaks an invariant makes the plan REFUSED.
authority: built and tested offline (architecture Tom Dyer; coding and writing Claude (Opus 5.5), 2026-11-25)
invariants: Invariants hold at every step: resident RAM within budget; RAM plus pageable within RAM plus swap; disk and fabric not overcommitted; no dirty write-back cache dropped
A write-back cache is flushed before it is dropped
A read-only store is verified against its digest before the root switches to it
procedure: Apply only PLANNED steps, in order; record each with completed(step, now); re-plan on the next event

qualification_boundaries.status: planner built; 48 offline checks pass on ooRexx 5.2.0 and 5.3.0
